password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the link below to choose a new one.
password_reset.expiry: This link can be used once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not be changed.

activation.subject: Activate your AzamTV account
activation.body: An account has been created for you in the AzamTV management system. Click the link below to set your password and activate it.
activation.expiry: This link can be used once and expires in {hours} hours.
activation.ignore: If you were not expecting this, contact ICT.

two_factor.subject: Your AzamTV login code
two_factor.body: Use this code to finish signing in:
two_factor.expiry: The code expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once.
two_factor.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, change your password and tell ICT.
